gramatica.titulo: Patterns: dar instruções passo a passo

personagens.YARA: a Brazilian woman technician (thirties, brown skin, shoulder-length curly black hair, dark navy work shirt and pants)
personagens.MARCOS: a Brazilian farmer (forties, brown skin, short black hair and a thick black mustache, dark teal cap, dark teal button-up work shirt and jeans)

gramatica.cenaAbertura: A wide split-screen view. On the left, {YARA} sits at a support desk in a bright repair office with shelves of GPS monitors and antennas, wearing a headset. On the right, {MARCOS} stands beside a green tractor and planter in a big soybean field, his phone at his ear.

slides.cena: Inside the cab of a green tractor, {MARCOS} holds his phone to his ear with one hand and presses a round green button in the top corner of the GPS monitor with the other. Through the cab windows, a wide soybean field.

frases.en: **Push** the cable in until it clicks.
frases.pt: Empurre o cabo até dar um clique.

slides.cena: At her support desk in a bright repair office, {YARA} talks into her headset with a calm, kind smile, one hand open in a gentle gesture. Her laptop shows a simple map with a small tractor icon, next to a coffee mug.

frases.en: **Please** hold the button in the top corner.
frases.pt: Por favor, segure o botão no canto de cima.
Desconecte o cabo devagar, por favor.

frases.en: **Please** call me back if it stops.
frases.pt: Por favor, me ligue de volta se parar.

slides.cena: Close-up behind the GPS monitor in a tractor cab: {MARCOS} carefully holds a black cable with two fingers, his face focused and cautious, his phone pressed between his ear and his shoulder.

frases.en: **Don't** worry, Marcos. I can help you.
frases.pt: Não se preocupe, Marcos. Eu posso te ajudar.
Não puxe o cabo com força.

frases.en: **Don't** touch the display during the calibration.
frases.pt: Não toque no visor durante a calibração.

slides.cena: In a bright repair office, {YARA} wears a headset and points at a whiteboard with four big, simple icons in a row, joined by arrows: a power symbol, an hourglass, a plug and a green check mark.

frases.pt: Por fim, tente o piloto automático de novo.

frases.en: **First**, park the tractor on flat ground.
frases.pt: Primeiro, estacione o trator num lugar plano.

frases.en: **Then** drive slowly in a straight line.
frases.pt: Depois, dirija devagar em linha reta.

revisao.pt: Me diga o que aparece no visor.
Por favor, espere a luz verde.
Não esqueça de me ligar de volta.

revisao.en: **First**, check the cable. **Then** restart the monitor.
revisao.pt: Primeiro, confira o cabo. Depois, reinicie o monitor.

gramatica.cenaRevisao: Golden sunset over a wide soybean field: {MARCOS} sits in the cab of his green tractor with his hands off the steering wheel, smiling and giving a thumbs up, as the planter behind him follows perfectly straight rows.
